Pengana Global Private Credit Trust ( PCX +0.77% ▲ ) has provided an update.

Pengana Global Private Credit Trust is a listed private credit fund on the ASX that offers investors diversified exposure to global private credit markets across strategies, sectors and geographies. It is managed by Pengana Credit with Mercer providing institutional fund sourcing and due diligence, and focuses heavily on senior secured loans to established businesses, fully hedged to the Australian dollar.

The trust reported a net return of 7.4% per annum since inception and a one-year return of 6.2%, with monthly distributions contributing to an 8% one-year distribution yield, supported by a portfolio of over 4,500 loans. Management highlighted that recent Australian market developments underscore concentration risks in local private credit, particularly real estate lending, and positioned PCX as a way to mitigate single-market and sector correlation by allocating capital across U.S. and European direct lending, structured credit and other strategies.

Learn more about TipRanks Premium In its September report, PCX detailed a portfolio tilt towards direct lending, income-focused classes and first-lien seniority, reinforcing its emphasis on capital protection and stability. The market backdrop remains driven by rising interest rates, with the U.S. Federal Reserve’s latest hike increasing pressure on highly leveraged borrowers, a context in which the trust’s focus on higher-quality credit and diversified exposures aims to support resilience and relatively low volatility for investors.

Pengana Global Private Credit Trust (ASX: PCX) is a listed investment vehicle providing retail investors access to global private credit markets that are typically reserved for institutions. Managed by Pengana Credit Pty Ltd with Mercer Consulting as investment consultant, the trust invests across more than 4,500 loans via over 29 specialist managers, focusing on senior secured lending to established, cash-generative businesses and is fully hedged to the Australian dollar.

PCX targets strong risk-adjusted returns with capital protection and consistent monthly income, offering daily ASX liquidity and quarterly off-market redemptions at net asset value. The portfolio is globally diversified across direct lending, structured credit, specialty finance and credit opportunities, with significant exposure to the U.S. and Europe and no exposure to Australian real estate, positioning it as a diversification tool away from concentrated domestic private credit markets.
